description:
The objective of the Activity is to facilitate the JJ/WBGSP scholar benefit payments for eleven (11) JJWBGSP scholars admitted to Brandeis University’s Master Programs in Sustainable International Development and Conflict Resolution and Coexistence.

The University shall facilitate the payment of the benefits to JJ/WBGSP scholars as described in Annex A; and may hire consultants (firms and individuals) or purchase limited goods required for the carrying out of the Activity. Any procurement by the University shall follow its own procedures.

Eligible Expenditures financed by the Bank: tuition fees, stipends, health insurance fees, travel allowances and air tickets

The University will pay directly to the scholar a stipend on a regular basis as least every three months for the duration of the student’s scholarship period under the Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program.

The University arranges travels for JJWB scholars directly: before their respective
program commences (no earlier than two weeks before program begins) and after the degree is completed (no more than two months after graduation).

description: Each sponsored student is given a Financial Guarantee which is a scholarship from IIE, that has worked in conjunction with their home nation. It is worldwide; so, the countries vary. The scholarship typically covers partial tuition, and fees, as well as health insurance, and students receive a monthly stipend from August of the first year to July of the next. Some students also receive a travel allowance, depending on the individual’s conditions. Many of the students also receive Graduate Assistantships and/or departmental scholarships on campus as well, which usually covers the remainder of tuition and/or fees. Each Scholarship Letter is sent at the beginning of their academic careers. Typically, it is renewed on an annual basis and lasts 2-4 years.
